results.name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an ab wheel with both hands. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Bend at your hips and knees to lower the ab wheel to the floor in front of your feet. Keep your arms extended and your back straight.
Slowly roll the ab wheel forward, extending your body into a plank position. Ensure your core remains tight and your back stays straight throughout the movement.
Roll the ab wheel back towards your feet, bending at your hips and knees to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you roll out and inhaling as you return.
Keep your back straight and avoid sagging or arching your lower back.
results.description: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Back, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Standing Cable Oblique Twist
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to a mid-pulley and grasp it with both hands. Bend your arms at 90 degrees and keep your elbows close to your torso sides.
Engage your core and keep your arms stationary as you twist your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body.
Twist until your shoulders are turned 90 degrees from the machine, feeling the stretch in your oblique muscles.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, keeping your arms straight. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Use your oblique muscles to twist, not your arms, hips, or legs.
Keep your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Adjust the cable machine weight to a challenging but manageable level.
results.description: Standing Cable Oblique Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back, Glutes.

results.name: Standing Oblique Crunch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, placing your hands behind your head with your elbows flared out to the sides. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Lift your right knee towards your right elbow while simultaneously bending your torso to the right to bring your elbow and knee closer together.
Return to the starting position by lowering your right leg and straightening your torso.
Repeat the movement on the left side, lifting your left knee towards your left elbow. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you crunch to the side and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Ensure your standing leg remains slightly bent to maintain balance.
Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward or backward during the exercise.
results.description: Standing Oblique Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

results.name: Star Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms and legs extended out to form an "X" shape. Keep your core engaged and your lower back pressed into the floor.
Crunch your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders and legs off the floor and lift your arms and legs towards each other, reaching your hands towards your ankles.
Lower your arms and legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your arm and leg, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your arms and legs off the floor.
Use a mat to provide cushioning and support for your back.
results.description: Star Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Abdominal Fallout
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about waist height. Stand in front of the hanging handles with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the handles with your palms facing down.
Engage your core and lean forward, allowing your arms to extend overhead while maintaining a straight body line from head to heels.
Lower your body until your arms are fully extended above your head, feeling the tension in your core.
Pull your body back to the starting position by pulling your arms back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lean forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Adjust the length of the suspension trainer straps to increase or decrease the difficulty of the exercise.
Keep your arms straight and avoid bending your elbows during the movement.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Abdominal Fallout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to an overhead position. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing forward) and hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the floor.
Engage your core and lift your knees up towards the ceiling to hip height, then pull your hips up to raise your legs to chest height.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control, keeping your core engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a controlled motion to prevent swinging.
Focus on using your core muscles to lift your legs and hips, avoiding excessive use of your hip flexors.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your legs and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Leg Hip Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back, Forearms.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to an overhead position. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing forward) and hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the floor.
Engage your core and lift your legs straight up towards the ceiling, aiming to bring your hips up as well.
Raise your legs until your body forms a V-shape, keeping them straight throughout the movement.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a controlled motion to prevent swinging.
Focus on using your core muscles to lift your legs and hips, avoiding excessive use of your hip flexors.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your legs and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back, Forearms.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Pull Through
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Sit on the floor with your legs extended and place your feet in the handles. Position your hands on the floor by your sides, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and press through your hands to lift your hips off the floor, coming into a reverse plank position. Your body should form a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your hips towards the floor with control, keeping your legs and arms straight. Stop just before your hips touch the floor.
Press through your hands and lift your hips to the reverse plank position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core tight to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement with a steady and controlled tempo to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Pull Through is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Forearms.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Reverse Ab Rollout
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Place your feet in the handles and assume a plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, placed directly under your shoulders, arms slightly bent, and body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and bend your knees to bring them towards your chest while lifting your hips upwards, creating a V position.
Continue bringing your knees towards your chest until your hips are fully bent and your knees are close to your chest.
Slowly extend your legs back to the starting plank position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you bring your knees towards your chest and inhale as you extend your legs back.
Start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase as your strength and flexibility improve.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them towards your ears.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Reverse Ab Rollout is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Supine Crunch
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Sit on your hips with your heels in the handles and legs extended straight, and place your arms by your sides for support.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor while keeping your legs straight.
Curl your knees towards your chest, and stop just before your knees touch your chest.
Slowly bring your legs back to starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core tight to maximize muscle engagement and prevent your back from arching
Start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase as your strength improves.
Incorporate this exercise into your routine for a comprehensive core workout.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Supine Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.
